About the Saturday Light Ride group ride

A Saturday night lights ride down Ocean Drive, through the Water Gardens and up Chaparral. Anything that rolls is welcome, including scooters and one-wheels. Run by the local LED light maker CC LED with the Hype Bike and Bicycle World crowds. Family friendly.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
